findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The On Deck row loads a first page of 20 series and pages further through a carousel loader; the server query has no 50-series cap, only the user's On Deck day limits.

findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: The Home carousel rows have no collapse control and nothing stores a collapsed state.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library screen has no Random button (only the library actions menu, filter, jump bar and bulk operations).

findings.fsdQuote: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
findings.note: For non-comic, non-book libraries such as Manga the default tab is Storyline; Volumes is only the default fallback for Comic and Book/Light Novel libraries.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can keep a private note on a series that only they can see.
findings.note: No series note feature exists in the series detail screen, the frontend models or the backend.
Series detail also has an Annotations tab (shown when the series has annotations) that the tab list leaves out.
A single-chapter volume also gets Related (reading lists) and Annotations tabs, and admins get an Edit button; none are mentioned.

findings.fsdQuote: A chapter's screen shows its release date, writers, cover artists, genres and tags
findings.note: The release date is shown only when the library is Comic or Comic (Flexible), not for every chapter.
Chapter detail also has an Annotations tab (shown when highlights exist) and an admin-only Edit button that are not described.
PDF files open in a separate PDF reader screen, which the FSD does not describe (it only names the image and book readers).

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: The brightness slider is validated with a minimum of 10 and a maximum of 100.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader has no slideshow/auto-advance mode or setting.
Image reader settings also include Auto Close Menu, Swipe to Paginate, Emulate Comic Book, Page Offset and Width Override, and the top bar has a keyboard shortcuts button; none are mentioned.

findings.fsdQuote: Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
findings.note: The font size is validated from 50 to 300.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: There is no text-to-speech / read aloud feature in the book reader; selection only offers copy, annotate and bookmark.
The book reader settings include a Disable Bookmark Icon switch and a Reset to Defaults button that are not described.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal is a daily scheduled cleanup, and only for series that are fully read AND whose publication status is Completed or Cancelled.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: Collection actions are Edit, Download, Delete, Promote and Unpromote; there is no CSV export for collections.
Collections synced from an outside service have a Sync Details button that opens a drawer; the FSD only mentions the synced count and last sync time.
The Collections screen supports bulk selection and bulk operations on collection cards, not mentioned in the FSD.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears once a list has more than 10 items.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No reading list sharing or public link exists in the UI or the reading list controller.
In edit/reorder mode there is a Remove Read button (for unpromoted lists the owner owns), and the actions menu offers Refresh covers, Download and Export as CBL (v1/v2); none are mentioned.
The person page has an actions menu (edit/merge, admin only), web link icons next to the name, and a cover image.
A Genres browse screen lists every genre with series and issue counts and opens All Series filtered to that genre; the FSD describes People and Tags only.
A Browse Annotations screen lists annotations with a filter panel, bulk operations and an Export button; it is not described.
An All Filters screen (smart filters list) exists inside scope and is not described.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The minimum password length is 6 characters, enforced by the identity options and the DTOs.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: There is no two-factor or authenticator app feature on the Account page or elsewhere in the code.
Users signed in through OpenID Connect see an OIDC section on Account with an Unlink button; not mentioned.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The prompt threshold is 100 MB (the preference tooltip is rendered with size 100).
Preferences also has Blur Unread Summaries and Collapse Series Relationships switches.
Preferences also has On Deck Last Progress (days) and On Deck Last Chapter Add (days) settings that control what appears in the On Deck row.
Preferences has an OPDS Settings group (Embed Progress Indicator, Include Continue From Entry) and a social Include Unknowns switch, not mentioned.
Preferences has an Annotations highlight colors bar, not mentioned.

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The General page has no Save button; changes are saved automatically about 300 ms after a valid edit.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: No maintenance mode setting exists in the settings page, DTOs or services.
The General page also has a Logging Level select and per-field reset buttons for base URL and IP addresses.
Users rows also have a Change Password button (admin resets another user's password), a profile link, and an identity provider icon.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form has only email, libraries, roles and age restriction; no expiry date.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The add-library form defaults Manage Collections to off.
The Libraries page has a bulk actions menu with row selection (e.g. copy settings to other libraries).

The library Advanced step also has Manage Reading Lists, Folder Watching, Allow Scrobbling, Allow Metadata Matching, Remove Prefix for Sort Name, Inherit Web Links, Default Language and Exclude Patterns; and editing offers Force Scan.
